payload.title: Wed 11/4: Stress and the evening plate
payload.purpose: Stress eating as a pattern, not a character flaw; coping skills the program teaches. Mention the day once.

captions.FB:
A long day doesn't make stress eating inevitable. When evening becomes the only quiet moment, reaching for food makes sense, but there are other ways to find that same comfort.

At the Bariatric Counseling Center, we teach coping skills that work when the day has worn you down. Our clients learn to recognize patterns, not judge them. They build a toolkit of responses that don't involve the kitchen.

Behavioral therapy. Dietary guidance. Culinary classes. Mindful movement. One program, not four.

Serving clients in San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

Link in the first comment.
